Why Apply?

- Enjoy hybrid and flexible working arrangements.

title: Receptionist
description:
Are you a professional, friendly and organised Receptionist looking to join a well-established law firm in the heart of Leeds?

We are seeking a Front of House Receptionist to become the welcoming face of our client's business. This is a varied role where no two days are the same, offering the opportunity to work within a professional legal environment while supporting colleagues across the wider business.

Location: Leeds City Centre (LS1)Salary: £25,000 - £26,000 per annumHours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm (37.5 hours per week)

The Role

As the first point of contact for clients and visitors, you will be responsible for delivering an exceptional front of house experience while providing administrative support to the legal team.

Key responsibilities include:
- Meeting and greeting clients, visitors and members of the public in a professional and welcoming manner
- Managing a busy switchboard and directing calls efficiently
- Preparing meeting rooms and ensuring they are presented to a high standard
- Ordering lunches and refreshments for meetings and events
- Assisting with the organisation and set-up of internal and client events
- Rearranging meeting room furniture where required (manual handling involved)
- Providing general administrative support, including data entry and maintaining legal case files
- Supporting departments across the wider business with day-to-day administrative tasks
- Ensuring the reception area remains tidy, professional and welcoming at all times

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people and takes pride in providing outstanding customer service.

You'll ideally have:
- A minimum of two years' reception or front of house experience
- Excellent communication skills, both face-to-face and over the telephone
- A professional, polished and well-presented appearance
- A warm, approachable and confident manner
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Good IT skills and the ability to accurately input data
- A proactive approach with a willingness to support colleagues across the business
- The ability to manage multiple tasks in a busy professional environment

What's on Offer?
- £25,000 - £26,000 per annum
- Monday to Friday working hours - no weekends
- 37.5-hour working week
- Leeds City Centre location with excellent transport links
- Opportunity to join a respected and supportive law firm
- A varied and rewarding role where you will play a key part in the day-to-day running of the office

If you're a confident and personable Receptionist who enjoys creating a positive first impression and thrives in a busy professional environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Insurance Broking Accounts Administrator (I-REC)
description:
JMG Group is a private equity-backed insurance brokerage, headquartered in Guiseley, Leeds, with a strong and growing presence across the UK. As a Top 30 broker with over 900 employees, we are experiencing rapid growth and continued success in the market.We place in excess of £350 million in Gross Written Premium annually, and our teams are highly respected throughout the insurance industry. At the heart of our business is a commitment to customer excellence and always doing the right thing-values that shape everything we do. Our success is driven by our talented people, modern systems, and robust processes, all of which enable us to deliver exceptional service and build long-term relationships with our clients and partners.The VacancyFollowing our recent growth and future acquisition strategy we are looking to add to our teams and recruit an additional Insurance Broking Accounts Administrator in our Insurer Reconciliation (IREC) division, based in our brand-new Finance hub in Yeadon, next to Leeds Bradford Airport.The overall objective of the role will be to provide a professional and efficient service to all customers, whilst ensuring full FCA compliance and following the CASS5 rules and guidelines. This applies to all businesses, processes, and PAS (Policy Admin System) operating systems that are utilised within the JMG Group of companies.Key responsibilities of the role will include:
- To ensure accounts are settled within the agreed credit terms and in accordance with the FCA CASS rules
- Referring any commission adjustments for review
- Ensure commission differences are referred back to handlers/brokers for a system re-debit, ensuring client ledger and insurer ledger contras are matched and correct line item settled to the insurer (all PAS)
- The reconciliation of statements, involving identifying discrepancies and conducting a high level of problem solving.
- Commission reconciliation in lieu of premium settlement
- Dealing with queries from insurance companies.
- Dealing with internal referrals and queries.
- Populate payment files ready for cashbook upload to banking platforms and validation in accordance with payment processes and dual authorisation reviews
- Identify and report to line manger any identified procedural of CASS5 breaches for reporting onto Pentana compliance system
- Accurately process and maintain company business accounts.
- Manage own accounts and raise any concerns with reporting line manager or technical level 3 team members

What we are looking for To be successful in this role the successful candidates will have an accounts administration background, ideally with insurer reconciliation experience or insurer knowledge and also have intermediate MS Excel experience, along with all other MS Office packages.Any broking systems experience such as Acturis, OGI, SSP & TAM would be a distinct advantage.What we offer
- Death in service
- Enhanced maternity/ paternity leave
- Company pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- Referral programme
- Casual dress
- Many more
